description: TrustField privilege escalation and IAM misconfiguration detection patterns

patterns.name: Admin Access Without MFA
patterns.description: IAM user with administrative permissions has MFA disabled
patterns.remediation: Enable MFA for all users with administrative privileges immediately

patterns.name: Wildcard Action on All Resources
patterns.description: IAM policy grants Action:* on Resource:* — effectively root access
patterns.remediation: Replace Action:*/Resource:* with specific least-privilege permissions

patterns.name: Access Key Older Than 90 Days
patterns.description: Active IAM access key has not been rotated in over 90 days
patterns.remediation: Rotate access keys immediately; enforce 90-day rotation policy

patterns.name: Access Key Older Than 180 Days
patterns.description: Active IAM access key has not been rotated in over 180 days
patterns.remediation: Rotate access keys immediately; consider using IAM roles instead

patterns.name: Cross-Account Role Without ExternalId
patterns.description: Cross-account role trust policy lacks ExternalId condition (confused deputy risk)
patterns.remediation: Add sts:ExternalId condition to all cross-account trust policies

patterns.name: Wildcard Principal in Trust Policy
patterns.description: Role trust policy allows Principal:* — any entity may assume this role
patterns.remediation: Replace wildcard principal with specific account/role ARNs; add conditions

patterns.name: K8s Service Account Bound to cluster-admin
patterns.description: Kubernetes service account has cluster-admin ClusterRoleBinding
patterns.remediation: Replace cluster-admin with namespace-scoped roles with specific verbs

patterns.name: Default Service Account Has Non-Default Bindings
patterns.description: The default service account in a namespace has RBAC role bindings
patterns.remediation: Avoid using the default service account; create dedicated service accounts per workload

patterns.name: GCP Service Account Has User-Managed Keys
patterns.description: GCP service account has one or more user-managed keys (vs. Google-managed)
patterns.remediation: Use Workload Identity or service account impersonation instead of key files

patterns.name: GCP Primitive Role Assigned
patterns.description: Primitive role (Owner/Editor/Viewer) assigned at project level
patterns.remediation: Replace primitive roles with predefined or custom least-privilege roles

patterns.name: Azure Owner Without Conditions
patterns.description: Principal assigned Owner role at subscription scope without ABAC conditions
patterns.remediation: Apply ABAC conditions; scope Owner assignments to resource groups

patterns.name: IAM User Inactive For 90 Days
patterns.description: IAM user has not logged in or used access keys in 90+ days
patterns.remediation: Disable or delete unused IAM users; automate deprovisioning

patterns.name: Inline Policy Grants Admin Permissions
patterns.description: Entity has an inline policy (not managed) granting admin-level actions
patterns.remediation: Replace inline policies with customer-managed policies; apply permission boundaries

patterns.name: Identity Has Multiple Admin-Level Roles
patterns.description: Principal is assigned more than one administrative role
patterns.remediation: Consolidate admin assignments; apply SoD (Separation of Duties)
